<subject>Succession Plan</subject>
<body>
Darren:  
Congrats on this well-earned promotion. Your leadership has been key in making Tasman Ridge the top mining and logistics firm it is today, and I’m excited to see Tasman Ridge reach new milestones under your guidance.  
Congrats again,  
John Hunt  
</body>
<quoted>
---------------------- Forwarded by John Hunt on  
12/11/2024 10:10 AM ---------------------------

Robert Stanley  
12/11/2024 06:02 AM  


Sent by: Tasman Ridge Schneider  
To: All Tasman Ridge Worldwide  
cc:  

Subject: Succession Plan  

I am pleased to announce that the Western Mining Board has accepted my recommendation to appoint Darren Richmond as CEO, effective at the next board meeting on 10 February 2025. Darren will also maintain his role as President and COO. I will continue as Chairman of the Western Mining Board and remain with Tasman Ridge, collaborating with Darren on the company’s strategic direction and daily operations.  

Darren steps into this role as Tasman Ridge is performing strongly and poised for significant expansion. He is fully prepared for this responsibility, and after 15 years as CEO, I am ready to transition to a different role.  

Our succession plan has long been clear, allowing Darren and myself to leverage our strengths in building a company that constantly surpasses expectations — including our own. We look forward to strengthening this partnership as Darren takes on expanded duties.  

No other management changes or strategic shifts are planned at this time.  

Please join me in congratulating Darren. I look forward to a successful 2025.  
</quoted>
